title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. vulgaris
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. vulgaris, commonly known as kidney vetch, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe skin conditions, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of kidney vetch include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial actions, attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of kidney vetch include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
